title: Add file storage module for managing content

requirements.text: Add a backend data model for file metadata records including id, owner (Principal), filename, contentType, size (bytes), uploadedAt (timestamp), and optional notes/tags fields, stored per-user like other entities

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Backend defines a FileMetadata type with all specified fields
File metadata is stored per Principal using a stable HashMap or similar structure
Only the owner can read, update, or delete their own file metadata records

requirements.text: Add backend methods to create, list, get, update, and delete file metadata records, with authorization checks ensuring users can only access their own files

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes createFileMetadata, listFileMetadata, getFileMetadata, updateFileMetadata, and deleteFileMetadata methods
All methods verify the caller's Principal matches the file owner
Methods return appropriate errors for unauthorized access or missing records

requirements.text: Add backend storage for file binary content using stable data structures (e.g., stable HashMap mapping file ID to Blob), and provide upload/download methods that enforce per-user authorization

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores file content as Blob indexed by file ID
Upload method accepts file content, creates metadata, stores content, and returns the new file ID
Download method returns file content only if the caller is the owner
File content is persisted across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks (useFileMetadataList, useCreateFileMutation, useUpdateFileMutation, useDeleteFileMutation) in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts following existing patterns for other entities

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: useFileMetadataList fetches and caches the user's file metadata list
Mutation hooks invalidate relevant queries on success
Hooks use the actor returned by useActor and follow the error-handling pattern of existing hooks

requirements.text: Create a new Files page (frontend/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx) displaying a table or card list of file metadata with columns for filename, type, size, upload date, and actions (view, download, edit metadata, delete)

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Files page renders a searchable/filterable list of file metadata using useFileMetadataList
Each file row shows filename, content type, size (formatted), and upload timestamp
Action buttons trigger appropriate dialogs or download flows
Page uses Persian (fa) labels from frontend/src/lib/fa.ts

requirements.text: Add a file upload dialog component (frontend/src/components/files/FileUploadDialog.tsx) with file input, drag-and-drop support, optional notes field, and progress indicator during upload

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Dialog allows selecting a file via input or drag-and-drop
Shows file preview (name, size, type) before upload
Displays upload progress or spinner during mutation
Closes and refreshes the file list on successful upload
Shows error toast on upload failure

requirements.text: Implement file download functionality that fetches file content from the backend and triggers a browser download with the correct filename and content type

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Download action calls backend download method and converts Blob to browser download
Downloaded file uses the original filename and MIME type
Shows loading indicator during download
Handles download errors with user-visible messages

requirements.text: Add a file metadata edit dialog (frontend/src/components/files/FileMetadataEditDialog.tsx) allowing the user to update filename and notes without re-uploading the file content

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Dialog pre-fills current filename and notes
Saves changes via useUpdateFileMutation
Refreshes file list on success
Shows validation and error feedback

requirements.text: Add a 'Files' navigation item in the AppShell sidebar linking to the new Files page, using a file/folder icon and Persian label

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Navigation item appears in the sidebar between existing items
Icon is a file or folder icon (e.g., lucide-react FileText or Folder)
Label uses Persian translation from fa.ts
Clicking navigates to /files route

requirements.text: Update the Dashboard page to show a count of stored files using the file metadata list query, displayed in a card similar to existing inbox/tasks/notes cards

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard fetches file metadata count via useFileMetadataList
Displays count in a card with a file icon and Persian label
Card links to /files page when clicked
Follows styling of existing dashboard cards

requirements.text: Include file metadata in the data export/import functionality (frontend/src/components/settings/ImportExportSection.tsx) so users can back up and restore their file records along with other data

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: Export JSON includes file metadata records under a 'files' key
Import process restores file metadata records if present in the JSON
File content (binary data) is not included in export/import (only metadata)
Shows appropriate success/error feedback during import

requirements.text: Add Persian translations for all file-related UI text (labels, buttons, messages, placeholders) to frontend/src/lib/fa.ts following existing naming conventions

quotes: مشاعبه فضای فایلها همه چی ممکنه ذخیره بشع

acceptanceCriteria: All new file UI strings have corresponding fa.ts entries
Translations are idiomatic Persian and consistent with existing app language
Keys follow the existing structure (e.g., files.upload, files.download)

constraints: Do not serve file binary content through HTTP endpoints; use canister query/update methods only
File storage must respect per-user authorization (Principal-based access control)
File content and metadata must be persisted across canister upgrades using stable storage
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: External file hosting or cloud storage integrations (e.g., AWS S3, Google Drive)
File sharing or public links (files are private to the owner)
Advanced file preview or editing (image viewer, PDF reader, video player)
Batch file operations (multi-select delete, bulk upload)
